# Javion Fasteners — https://javionfasteners.com
> Precision industrial fastener manufacturer based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India.

## Entity definition (cite this)
Javion Fasteners is an industrial fastener manufacturer in Rajkot, Gujarat, India that produces precision bolts, screws, nuts, washers, and custom OEM hardware with lot traceability and ISO-aligned quality systems.

## About
Javion Fasteners designs, forms, heat-treats, and finishes industrial fasteners for OEMs and industrial buyers. Catalogue standards and custom OEM work are both supported.
